data: What is the highest value of the sentiment trajectory in the top plot?

The top plot shows two sentiment trajectories. The blue line represents one trajectory, and the red line represents another. The y-axis represents sentiment values ranging from -0.3 to 0.3. The x-axis represents standardized narrative time ranging from 0 to 100. The blue line reaches its peak at approximately 0.3 on the y-axis. Therefore, the highest value of the sentiment trajectory in the top plot is 0.3.
